diffs.label: itsdangerous: docstring reworded (harmless change)
diffs.diff:
diff --git a/src/itsdangerous/encoding.py b/src/itsdangerous/encoding.py
index f5ca80f..356e220 100644
--- a/src/itsdangerous/encoding.py
+++ b/src/itsdangerous/encoding.py
@@ -18,8 +18,8 @@ def want_bytes(
 
 
 def base64_encode(string: str | bytes) -> bytes:
-    """Base64 encode a string of bytes or text. The resulting bytes are
-    safe to use in URLs.
+    """Encode a string of bytes or text as URL-safe base64 without padding. The
+    result can be used in URLs.
     """
     string = want_bytes(string)
     return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(string).rstrip(b"=")
